slides: Write EVERYTHING down.
Every task, idea and 'I should'. Get it out of your head.
TODAY: max 3 tasks.
If everything is a priority, nothing is.
LATER: the parking lot.
Important, but not today. It's safe here.
NEVER: delete without guilt.
If it's been there 3 weeks, it was never going to happen.
Only look at TODAY.
Hide the other two lists. Out of sight, out of your head.
Done all 3? Stop.
Pick one more from LATER only if you really want to.

slides: A
The Starter
Starts 10 things. Finishes none. FIX: one sticky note, one task, until it's done.
B
The Perfectionist
Can't start until it's perfect. FIX: set a timer for 10 minutes and do a bad version.
C
The Scroller
'Just checking one thing' = 1 hour gone. FIX: phone in another room during work.
D
The Night Owl
Only works under pressure at 11pm. FIX: fake a deadline. Tell someone you'll send it by noon.

Starting with the easy stuff.
Your best energy goes to emails. The real work gets the leftovers.
Notifications on everything.
Every ping costs you minutes to get back in the zone.
No end time for work.
If work never ends, your brain never fully starts.
